steps.message:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-10, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104.3 | 6.31 | 6.31
2 | 416.7 | 17.57 | 23.88
3 | 264.5 | 2.29 | 26.17
4 | 856.9 | 2.63 | 28.80
5 | 641.5 | 26.88 | 55.68
6 | 7698.1 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we analyze the resistivities of the layers in depth order:
$\rho_1 = 104.3$
$\rho_2 = 416.7$
$\rho_3 = 264.5$
$\rho_4 = 856.9$
$\rho_5 = 641.5$
$\rho_6 = 7698.1$

Next, we evaluate each group of three consecutive layers:
1.  **Layers 1-2-3**: $\rho_1=104.3, \rho_2=416.7, \rho_3=264.5$.
    Since $104.3 < 416.7$ and $416.7 > 264.5$, the pattern is $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$, which corresponds to the letter **K**.
2.  **Layers 2-3-4**: $\rho_2=416.7, \rho_3=264.5, \rho_4=856.9$.
    Since $416.7 > 264.5$ and $264.5 < 856.9$, the pattern is $\rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4$, which corresponds to the letter **H**.
3.  **Layers 3-4-5**: $\rho_3=264.5, \rho_4=856.9, \rho_5=641.5$.
    Since $264.5 < 856.9$ and $856.9 > 641.5$, the pattern is $\rho_3 < \rho_4 > \rho_5$, which corresponds to the letter **K**.
4.  **Layers 4-5-6**: $\rho_4=856.9, \rho_5=641.5, \rho_6=7698.1$.
    Since $856.9 > 641.5$ and $641.5 < 7698.1$, the pattern is $\rho_4 > \rho_5 < \rho_6$, which corresponds to the letter **H**.

The resulting sequence of letters is KHKH.

{"curve_type": "KHKH"}
